decisions.reason: Applying supplied dates to all date fields does not change the allocated-budget values or their value source.
The date-field consistency decision does not change the session-count formula, personnel amounts, or budget-gap allocation rule.
The candidate records service weekdays and time slots, which remain unchanged; agreement start and end dates are owned by the source Requirement.
Applying supplied dates consistently does not change the missing contract-ID statuses.
The document designation remains 286R independently of how supplied dates are applied.
The date-field decision does not alter the non-personnel allocation rule or approved budget lines.
Signature requirement and placement are unaffected by applying supplied dates to date fields.
The separately specified seven-week value remains unchanged; the source decision only resolves which supplied dates populate date fields.
The equivalence of NCA and NH as the same school is unaffected by the date-field application rule.
